name: Stud Fish Models
summary: 20 stud-style aquatic creatures, including sharks, whale shark, blue tang, seahorse, koi, octopus, manta ray and axolotl.
install: Import fish into ServerStorage, then copy individual models into Workspace. These are decorative MeshPart assemblies; add your own movement, animation and game logic. Preserve colors, meshes and relative part transforms.
limits: Every model has front/back static Studio previews. No AI, swimming, rig animation, collision or gameplay certification.
credit: Original fish_* instance names and mesh references are retained.
verification: Static Studio Edit inspection on isolated clones; no runtime behavior certification. Native instance counts/root names matched the supplied imports. Original scripts were disabled on static preview clones.
